rows.description: Turn Amazon Echos (Echo Dot 3, Echo Dot 2, Echo 2) into local Home Assistant voice satellites. Keeps Amazon's mic processing and wake word engine, replaces Alexa with a small C daemon speaking ESPHome or Wyoming. Multiroom music via Music Assistant, Bluetooth speaker and proxy, no cloud.
Turn any Android device into a beautiful, dedicated Home Assistant kiosk. Purpose-built for Home Assistant from the ground up.
Alexa replacement and controller for Echo Dot 2nd Generation device.
